title: San Juan City reaffirms support for educators on World Teachers' Day

blocks.text: SAN JUAN CITY — The city government of San Juan honored teachers for their dedication and contributions during the Department of Education’s San Juan division celebration of World Teachers’ Day on Oct. 2, 2026, at the Makabagong San Juan Theater at the Makabagong San Juan National Government Center. Mayor Francis Zamora, his son, Rocco Zamora, who serves as his special assistant, Vice Mayor Angelo Agcaoili and members of the City Council joined the celebration, recognizing teachers’ role in educating and shaping the future of San Juaneño youth.
